mapper.sql: ID, USERNAME, PASSWORD_HASH, REAL_NAME, STATUS, FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT, LOCKED_UNTIL, LAST_LOGIN_AT, PASSWORD_CHANGED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, VERSION_NO
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM SYS_USER U WHERE U.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_USER_ROLE UR INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE R ON R.ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = U.ID AND R.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND R.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY U.ID ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT R.ROLE_CODE FROM SYS_ROLE R INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE UR ON UR.ROLE_ID = R.ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY R.ROLE_CODE
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM SYS_ROLE WHERE ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_USER_ROLE (USER_ID, ROLE_ID) SELECT #{userId}, R.ID FROM SYS_ROLE R WHERE R.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND R.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_USER_ROLE EXISTING WHERE EXISTING.USER_ID = #{userId} AND EXISTING.ROLE_ID = R.ID )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYS_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID=#{userId} AND ROLE_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM SYS_ROLE WHERE ROLE_CODE=#{roleCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE SYS_USER SET FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT + 1, STATUS = CASE WHEN FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT + 1 >= #{maxFailedAttempts} THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE STATUS END, LOCKED_UNTIL = CASE WHEN FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT + 1 >= #{maxFailedAttempts} AND LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL THEN #{lockUntil} ELSE LOCKED_UNTIL END, UPDATED_AT = #{occurredAt}, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'LOCKED')
UPDATE SYS_USER SET FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, LAST_LOGIN_AT = #{occurredAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{occurredAt}, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE SYS_USER SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, UPDATED_AT = #{occurredAt}, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'LOCKED' AND LOCKED_UNTIL IS NOT NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL <= #{occurredAt}
